reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed donor-average treatment contrast with hierarchical comparison, donor-grouped resampling and null calibration, and protected donor-level validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original experimental Methods/supplements to verify allocation and sampling conditions and release-specific model protocols. Reconstructing identifiers and naming prior evidence alone is insufficient.

checks.quote: it indicates that the biological effect is masked by high donor variance
checks.reason: High ICC or lost significance does not establish that a true effect exists but is masked. The packet explicitly supports uncertainty rather than this affirmative biological explanation.
No operational endpoint/test selection or specified hierarchical distribution/link/fitting algorithm.
No objective technical reference calibration or procedure defining assay acceptance/failure thresholds.
Planning is based on an observed pilot effect without an independent minimum meaningful effect, stated power/precision target or propagation of pilot uncertainty.
Randomization and blinding are present but processing/acquisition order is not prospectively balanced across arms/batches or an equivalent justified.
No outcome-independent donor/cell exclusion ledger, missing-donor policy or separation of biological loss from technical failure.
No explicit interval construction, multiplicity procedure or allocation-restricted permutation implementation is specified.

checks.quote: The hierarchical model will remain structurally valid
checks.reason: Correct nesting does not ensure a particular model remains valid at very small donor n; likelihood/link, convergence and reference-distribution assumptions must be checked.
No bounded parameter/assumption exploration with criteria and lock.
No operational sequence diagnosing identity/reference/batch failure or model nonconvergence with a targeted repair and retest.
No explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after revising a failed procedure.

checks.quote: The study is accepted as valid if the null calibration yields an expected uniform distribution
checks.reason: Discrete randomization p-values need not be exactly uniform; calibration alone is also not a rule for positive, negative or falsifying biological conclusions.

checks.quote: evaluate whether the observed biological effect generalizes
checks.reason: No operational held-out treatment-effect comparison/interval and acceptance metric; applying a fitted hierarchical model is not by itself independent confirmation of the contrast.
No immutable inputs, pinned computational environment or exact command provenance.
Donor splitting is specified but fitted preprocessing/features/thresholds are not explicitly learned only from training donors.
No operational treatment-batch/time-confounding gate, informative-missingness sensitivity or null stress across uncertain variance/cluster-size scenarios.
No clean-environment numerical rerun with tolerances and runtime/resource/failure logs.

The basic allocation-unit distinction, donor bootstrap and reporting of donor/cell counts are correct. Many executable safeguards are absent, model validity is overstated, and high ICC is incorrectly interpreted as masking a real effect rather than leaving its existence uncertain.
